title: Feature Request: Smart Band integration for Xiaomi Mi Band 3
symptom: The user requests integration of notifications into the Xiaomi Mi Band 3 smart band, specifically a continuous notification every 5 or 10 minutes displaying the latest glucose level and trend arrow, not just high/low alerts.
fix: A user (bigdigital) developed a custom xDrip integration for Mi Band, providing instructions and a new version that works with Mi Band 2, 3, and 4. The integration sends glucose level and trend arrow notifications to the band. For Mi Band 2 and 3, it works with MiFit using the 'bg reading as notifications' option. The fix is to use this custom integration.
evidence_quote: Today i've released a new version https://bigdigital.home.blog/2020/01/23/future-of-the-xdrip-miband-project/ which should work better for mibandv4 . The v2 and v3 would work as before . If this version would be stable, i’ll create a pull request for the Xdrip master record.
